## Change

Describe the behavior and the reason for this change. Link a related issue when useful.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their OS; explain any affected path not checked. The default suite uses a mock provider.

## Content and safety

Confirm that test samples and assets are original or authorized and that the diff contains no credentials or private user data. If user-facing behavior or setup changed, update both READMEs and the relevant guide.

Sign off each contribution commit with `git commit -s` under the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
